rationale: This empirical survey study examines general urban governance models and their effects on the identity, democratic perceptions, and role behavior of municipal councillors in Switzerland. It has no connection to household or community water or sanitation service access (E01).
plain_vs_narrow_note: Excluded under both readings due to failing Criterion 1 and Criterion 4 (general political science study of Swiss city councillors with no water or sanitation service access component).

evidence_quotes.quote: An Analysis of the Political Influence, the Role Perceptions, and the Behavior of Swiss City Councillors in Different Urban Governance Contexts
the article investigates the implications of new models of urban governance on the identity, the notion of democracy, the perceptions, and the role behavior of city councillors.
draws on multilevel analyses of a comprehensive survey of all city councillors in Switzerland.
